methodology.title: ReGen Performance Methodology | Connecting the Body as One System
methodology.description: We assess how the body receives information, organizes movement and transfers force as an integrated system.

methodology.title: Pillar 01 — THE BREATH | Breathing Mechanics & Movement
methodology.description: How you breathe influences rib-cage movement, pressure management, trunk stability and the way your body organizes movement.

methodology.title: Pillar 02 — THE GROUND | Foot Mechanics & Tripod Foot
methodology.description: Your feet provide both sensory information and a foundation for managing force during movement.

methodology.title: Pillar 03 — THE LINE | Kinetic Chains & Force Transfer
methodology.description: Human movement requires multiple joints and muscles to coordinate as kinetic chains.

methodology.title: Pillar 04 — THE EXPRESSION | Rib Cage, Scapula & Shoulder Mechanics
methodology.description: The rib cage provides the surface on which the scapula moves, while the trunk, scapula, shoulder and arm coordinate to transfer force toward the hand.

methodology.title: Pillar 05 — THE SIGNAL | Nervous System, Sensory Input & Movement
methodology.description: Before you move, your nervous system is constantly processing information from your eyes, vestibular system, joints, muscles, skin, breathing and environment.
